01668:     fun uploadRawFile(fileName: String, bytes: ByteArray, context: Context? = null) {
01669:         val path = _currentPath.value.trimEnd('/')
01670:         val fullPath = if (path.isEmpty()) "/$fileName" else "$path/$fileName"
01671:         uploadRawFileToPath(fullPath, bytes, context)
01672:     }
01673:
01674:     fun uploadRawFileToPath(fullPath: String, bytes: ByteArray, context: Context? = null) {
01675:         val fileName = fullPath.substringAfterLast('/')
01676:         val fileSize = bytes.size.toLong()
01677:
01678:         val session = ActiveUploadSession(
01679:             filePath = fullPath,
01680:             fileName = fileName,
01681:             sentBytes = 0L,
01682:             totalSize = fileSize,
01683:             uploadJob = null,
01684:             context = context
01685:         )
01686:         activeUploads[fullPath] = session
01687:
01688:         val progress = TransferProgress(
01689:             fileName = fileName,
01690:             filePath = fullPath,
01691:             isUpload = true,
01692:             bytesTransferred = 0L,
01693:             totalBytes = fileSize
01694:         )
01695:         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != fullPath } + progress
01696:
01697:         if (context != null) {
01698:             updateUploadNotification(context, fileName, fullPath, 0L, fileSize)
01699:         }
01700:
01701:         session.uploadJob = scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
01702:             var uploadSuccess = false
01703:
01704:             while (!uploadSuccess && activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
01705:                 try {
01706:                     if (!ensureConnected()) {
01707:                         delay(2000)
01708:                         continue
01709:                     }
01710:
01711:                     session.sentBytes = 0L
01712:                     _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01713:                         if (it.filePath == fullPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = 0L, totalBytes = fileSize) else it
01714:                     }
01715:
01716:                     val req = JsonObject().apply {
01717:                         addProperty("action", "upload")
01718:                         addProperty("path", fullPath)
01719:                         addProperty("size", bytes.size)
01720:                     }
01721:                     val ws = webSocket
01722:                     if (ws == null || !ws.send(req.toString())) {
01723:                         throw java.io.IOException("WebSocket disconnected before upload start")
01724:                     }
01725:
01726:                     delay(150)
01727:
01728:                     val chunkSize = 64 * 1024
01729:                     var offset = 0
01730:                     val total = bytes.size
01731:
01732:                     if (total == 0) {
01733:                         if (ws.send(ByteString.EMPTY)) {
01734:                             uploadSuccess = true
01735:                         } else {
01736:                             throw java.io.IOException("Failed to send empty byte string")
01737:                         }
01738:                     } else {
01739:                         while (offset < total && activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
01740:                             val length = minOf(chunkSize, total - offset)
01741:                             val chunk = ByteString.of(*bytes.copyOfRange(offset, offset + length))
01742:                             val currentWs = webSocket
01743:
01744:                             if (currentWs == null || !isConnected() || !currentWs.send(chunk)) {
01745:                                 throw java.io.IOException("WebSocket disconnected or chunk send failed")
01746:                             }
01747:
01748:                             offset += length
01749:
01750:                             session.sentBytes = offset.toLong()
01751:                             val currOffset = offset.toLong()
01752:                             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01753:                                 if (it.filePath == fullPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = currOffset) else it
01754:                             }
01755:
01756:                             if (context != null) {
01757:                                 updateUploadNotification(context, fileName, fullPath, currOffset, total.toLong())
01758:                             }
01759:                             delay(10)
01760:                         }
01761:                         if (offset >= total && activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath)) {
01762:                             uploadSuccess = true
01763:                         }
01764:                     }
01765:
01766:                     if (uploadSuccess && activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath)) {
01767:                         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01768:                             if (it.filePath == fullPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = fileSize, isCompleted = true) else it
01769:                         }
01770:
01771:                         if (context != null) {
01772:                             showUploadCompleteNotification(context, fileName, fullPath, fileSize)
01773:                         }
01774:
01775:                         delay(1500)
01776:                         activeUploads.remove(fullPath)
01777:                         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != fullPath }
01778:                         listDirectory(_currentPath.value)
01779:                     } else if (activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath)) {
01780:                         throw java.io.IOException("Raw upload loop ended incomplete ($offset / $total)")
01781:                     }
01782:                 } catch (e: Exception) {
01783:                     if (activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
01784:                         Log.w("MeshFilesUpload", "Raw upload interrupted for $fullPath (${e.localizedMessage}). Deleting incomplete remote file and restarting...")
01785:
01786:                         if (context != null) {
01787:                             withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
01788:                                 Toast.makeText(context, context.getString(R.string.unstable_network_reconnecting_upload), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
01789:                             }
01790:                         }
01791:
01792:                         deleteRemoteFilePath(fullPath)
01793:                         delay(2000)
01794:                     }
01795:                 }
01796:             }
01797:
01798:             if (!uploadSuccess) {
01799:                 activeUploads.remove(fullPath)
01800:                 _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != fullPath }
01801:                 deleteRemoteFilePath(fullPath)
01802:             }
01803:         }
01804:     }

01806:     fun uploadUri(uri: Uri, context: Context, customFileName: String? = null) {
01807:         val fileName = customFileName?.trim()?.ifBlank { null } ?: getFileNameFromUri(context, uri)
01808:         val path = _currentPath.value.trimEnd('/')
01809:         val fullPath = if (path.isEmpty()) "/$fileName" else "$path/$fileName"
01810:         uploadUriToPath(fullPath, uri, context)
01811:     }
01812:
01813:     fun uploadUriToPath(fullPath: String, uri: Uri, context: Context) {
01814:         val fileName = fullPath.substringAfterLast('/')
01815:         val fileSize = getFileSizeFromUri(context, uri)
01816:
01817:         val session = ActiveUploadSession(
01818:             filePath = fullPath,
01819:             fileName = fileName,
01820:             sentBytes = 0L,
01821:             totalSize = fileSize,
01822:             uploadJob = null,
01823:             context = context
01824:         )

01828:             fileName = fileName,
01829:             filePath = fullPath,
01830:             isUpload = true,
01831:             bytesTransferred = 0L,
01832:             totalBytes = fileSize
01833:         )
01834:         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != fullPath } + progress
01835:

01837:

01839:             var uploadSuccess = false
01840:

01842:                 try {

01844:                         delay(2000)

01846:                     }
01847:

01851:                     }
01852:
01853:                     val req = JsonObject().apply {
01854:                         addProperty("action", "upload")
01855:                         addProperty("path", fullPath)
01856:                         addProperty("size", fileSize)

01859:                     if (ws == null || !ws.send(req.toString())) {
01860:                         throw java.io.IOException("WebSocket disconnected before upload start")

01862:
01863:                     delay(150)
01864:
01865:                     val chunkSize = 64 * 1024
01866:                     var totalSent = 0L
01867:
01868:                     val inputStream = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
01869:                     if (inputStream == null) {
01870:                         Log.e("MeshFilesUpload", "Could not open input stream for $uri")
01871:                         break
01872:                     }
01873:
01874:                     inputStream.use { stream ->
01875:                         val buffer = ByteArray(chunkSize)
01876:                         while (activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
01877:                             val bytesRead = stream.read(buffer)
01878:                             if (bytesRead == -1) break
01879:
01880:                             val chunk = ByteString.of(*buffer.copyOfRange(0, bytesRead))
01881:                             val currentWs = webSocket
01882:
01883:                             if (currentWs == null || !isConnected() || !currentWs.send(chunk)) {
01884:                                 throw java.io.IOException("WebSocket disconnected or chunk send failed")
01885:                             }
01886:
01887:                             totalSent += bytesRead
01888:
01889:                             session.sentBytes = totalSent
01890:                             val currOffset = totalSent
01891:                             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01892:                                 if (it.filePath == fullPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = currOffset, totalBytes = maxOf(fileSize, currOffset)) else it
01893:                             }
01894:
01895:                             updateUploadNotification(context, fileName, fullPath, currOffset, maxOf(fileSize, currOffset))
01896:                             delay(10)
01897:                         }
01898:                     }
01899:
01900:                     if (totalSent >= fileSize && activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath)) {
01901:                         uploadSuccess = true
01902:                         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01903:                             if (it.filePath == fullPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = totalSent, totalBytes = totalSent, isCompleted = true) else it
01904:                         }
01905:
01906:                         showUploadCompleteNotification(context, fileName, fullPath, totalSent)
01907:
01908:                         delay(1500)
01909:                         activeUploads.remove(fullPath)
01910:                         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != fullPath }
01911:                         listDirectory(_currentPath.value)
01912:                     } else if (activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath)) {
01913:                         throw java.io.IOException("Upload loop ended incomplete ($totalSent / $fileSize)")
01914:                     }
01915:                 } catch (e: Exception) {
01916:                     if (activeUploads.containsKey(fullPath) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
01917:                         Log.w("MeshFilesUpload", "Upload interrupted for $fullPath (${e.localizedMessage}). Deleting incomplete remote file and restarting...")
